ServiceNow compensation varies by:
  region, company size, industry
  consulting vs. in-house, experience level

-> any single figure stated here would mislead
   many readers, and go stale within a year
caption: This lesson teaches the research method, not a number.

eyebrow: Research before you hear a number

steps.label: Public salary surveys
steps.sub: cross-check more than one — self-reported data is noisy

steps.label: Comparable postings
steps.sub: roles that list a real range for the same level and region

steps.label: Professional communities
steps.sub: people in similar roles discussing real, current figures

steps.label: Walk-away point
steps.sub: decide it in advance, before stress or excitement can distort it

steps.label: Beyond base pay
steps.sub: bonus payout history, benefits, time off, flexibility, start date

steps.label: Ask clearly
steps.sub: name what matters to you, backed by the research you already did
